name: Mike Tomford · DJ Colbert · Kathy Moulton
description: The parental layer beneath JD's early social world. Mike Tomford (Nathaniel and CJ's father), DJ Colbert (Caden and Judson's father, Philip Dennis's uncle), and Kathy Moulton (Joel's mother) were all part of the same 1980s–90s CFC Madrid community as John Sr. Their continued presence at CFC meant their kids and JD grew up in the same orbit by design.
